description: Use to set up a standard deal in one call instead of assembling conditions: pick a template and fill its fields. Returns the approve and createAgreement transactions to send from the payer. No account, no signature.

asset.description: "eth", "usdg" or a token address. Default eth.

dealId.description: after_deal: the Bull escrow deal that must settle first.

expiryHours.description: Hours until the payer can be refunded. Default 72.

k.description: panel: how many arbiters must vote yes.

template.description: Template name from bull_agreement_templates, e.g. arbiter_escrow, milestones, optimistic, panel, after_deal, balance_trigger, price_trigger, token_price_trigger, performance_bond.

windowHours.description: optimistic: hours the payer has to object. Default 24.

name: bull_agreement_from_template
